Test Brevo

This is a temporary test post used to validate the end-to-end blog publishing and email notification workflow.

If you are seeing this during testing, the Markdown-to-static publishing flow is working.

What this validates

  • The blog generator publishes Markdown posts.
  • The homepage Blog section updates.
  • The GitHub Actions workflow can deploy the generated static site.
  • The notification helper can discover this post from the manifest.
